# azion_application_device_groups (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "azion_application_device_groups" "example" {
  application_id = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `application_id` (Number) The application identifier.

### Read-Only

- `counter` (Number) The total count of device groups.
- `id` (String) Numeric identifier of the data source.
- `results` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results))
- `total_pages` (Number) The total number of pages.

<a id="nestedatt--results"></a>
### Nested Schema for `results`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) The creation timestamp of the device group.
- `id` (Number) The device group identifier.
- `name` (String) Name of the device group.
- `user_agent` (String) Regular expression pattern to identify user agents.
